title: A1c reference ranges
text: A1c < 5.7% is generally considered normal. A1c 5.7-6.4% suggests increased diabetes risk. A1c >= 6.5% may be consistent with diabetes in appropriate clinical context.

title: eGFR interpretation
text: eGFR >= 90 is typically normal. eGFR 60-89 may indicate mild reduction. eGFR 30-59 suggests moderate reduction; <30 indicates severe reduction and may require medication adjustments.

title: LDL interpretation
text: LDL levels should be interpreted with overall cardiovascular risk. Very high LDL (>=190 mg/dL) suggests high risk and usually warrants intensive therapy.
